description: Subjects and time allocation (JP per year: intrakurikuler, kokurikuler, total) per level and grade for every school level: SD, SMP, SMA, SMK (3- and 4-year), SDLB, SMPLB, SMALB and Paket A/B/C (SKK per phase) from Permendikdasmen 13/2025, and the madrasah tables MI, MTs, MA, MAK, MILB, MTsLB, MALB from KMA 1503/2025; PAUD/RA minutes, phases, footnotes, electives, implementation rules and errata.
status: ready (51 JP tables + 3 SKK tables; 144 printed totals checked; 7 errata, 1 unresolved)
source: Permendikdasmen 13/2025 Lampiran II (in force 2025-07-15), Permendikbudristek 12/2024 Pasal 33, KMA 1503/2025 Lampiran II BAB III (2025-09-22). Raw PDFs and SOURCE.txt in sources/mapel/
procedure: Transcribed by hand into tools/converters/mapel.py (Permendikdasmen from its text layer with merged cells checked on page images; the scanned KMA cell by cell from page images, OCR only as a draft). The script checks every row and every printed total row, refuses printed values without an erratum, then writes mapel.json. SD/MI, SDLB/MILB and MI tables match sinaubareng's independently checked data (145 rows) apart from the recorded errata. Version = date of the newest source (KMA 1503/2025).
